newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Penoles outlines metals hedging.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Penoles outlines metals hedging.

text.p: Industrias Penoles, the world's largest refined silver producer, outlined its hedging policies for metals in 1997.
In a conference call to analysts, Penoles said this year it will hedge 20 percent of gold mine production, 30 percent of silver mine production and 5 percent of zinc mine production.
"The company is bullish on zinc, hence the willingness for greater exposure," Finamex mining analyst Chris Albi said in a report.

"The hedging is not straightforward but has been generally at a floor slightly above currenbt prices and a ceiling well above current prices," Warwick Jones, analyst at Robert Fleming Inc also said in an update.
